decisions.reason: The source revises landing-page hero wording and layout only; it does not direct any change to the separate Mission page copy.
The requested wording and layout changes are scoped to the landing-page hero and do not alter the About page content.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY capturing flexible landing-page placement and size, non-overlap, image cropping, and removal of mandatory headline integration.
The source edits visible landing-page hero and prize-area phrases; it does not necessarily revise the separately approved FAQ content.
The source changes marketing wording and emphasis but preserves the existing one-$500-winner-per-100-sales mechanism and referral-based eligibility.
The source does not change wallet provisioning, dashboard access, ticket visibility, commission access, or prize-delivery behavior for fiat buyers.
The source does not remove or revise the next-draw sales counter; its changes concern hero presentation and adjacent marketing copy.
The source does not change the email-notification trigger, recipient condition, delivery channel, or winner guidance.
Using 'Project Rebuild' as the hero headline is consistent with the existing project name and does not change the branding requirement.
The source does not change the $15 mint price, no-hidden-fees condition, or advertised price commitment.
The '$5 unlimited, instant commission' phrase restates the current commission behavior for emphasis without changing its amount, trigger, recipient, timing, or limits.
The source changes landing-page prize wording but does not alter automatic prize transfer, payment destination, or Winners-page announcement behavior.
